% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): settings and macros inside TeX brace
% groups of the axis body stay in the group (behaviour AB4).
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xmin=0, xmax=4, ymin=0, ymax=8, domain=0:1, samples=2]
\def\k{1}
{\pgfplotsset{domain=2:4, samples=3}\def\k{4}
  \addplot {x+\k};
  \pgfplotsset{title=Lost, every axis plot/.append style={dashed}}}
\addplot {x+\k};
{\tikzset{mark=x}\addplot[red] {2*x};}
\tikzset{mark=o}
\addplot[blue] {x+6};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
